lead_raw_text:
The structure of La2Co4Al2O12 (reduced formula LaCo2AlO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al and Co centers each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while La centers show nine O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between AlO6 and CoO6 octahedra, and edge-sharing between AlO6 octahedra and La-centered 9-vertex polyhedra, forming a 3-dimensional connected network.
